title: IS: Infinite Stratos 2 - Hitonatsu no Omoide
justification: AniList 20045 (OVA, 1 episode(s) from 2013-10-30) is AniDB 9849's special(s) S1 'Hitonatsu no Omoide', aired 2013-10-30, and AniDB lists MAL 20045 on AniDB 9849. The parent's patched mapping list places S1 on TVDB 219131 0x3 'IS: Infinite Stratos 2 Long Vacation Edition - The Memories of One Summer', also 2013-10-30.
